title: Application of Deep Learning for Real-Time Ablation Zone Measurement in Ultrasound Imaging.
summary: Publisher full text read in Chrome, Methods and Results: Mask2Former trained with an 80/10/10 data split automated ablation-zone segmentation/measurement; 308 RFA cases/runs and 7,275 ultrasound images were compared with manual measurement, with reported agreement. Technical/clinical measurement proof; finite dataset and manual reference limit generalization. AI role: Mask2Former image segmentation. The article appeared in Cancers.
